natural: shaking the past and dazzling the present

meaning.en: Of a great achievement: astonishing past and present alike, unparalleled in history.
meaning.zh: 使古代震惊、使当代炫耀，形容功业伟大，前所未有。

examples.zh: 长征是震古烁今的壮举。
examples.en: The Long March was an epoch-making feat.

examples.zh: 这项工程震古烁今，让世界为之惊叹。
examples.en: The project is unparalleled in history and amazed the world.

usage.en: Praise for great deeds, in formal speech and writing. Note 烁 is read shuò. Usually attributive.
usage.zh: 用于称颂伟大功业，多见于庄重场合。“烁”读shuò。多作定语。

natural: slow measures cannot meet an urgent need

meaning.en: A slow remedy cannot meet an urgent need.
meaning.zh: 慢的办法解决不了急迫的需要。

examples.zh: 灾区急需物资，从外地调运缓不济急。
examples.en: The disaster area urgently needs supplies, and shipping from afar would be too slow.

examples.zh: 这种治疗方式效果慢，缓不济急。
examples.en: This treatment works slowly and cannot meet the urgent need.

usage.en: Often paired with 远水救不了近火. Usually refers to a solution that arrives too late. Predicate.
usage.zh: 常与“远水救不了近火”意近。指办法来得太迟。多作谓语。

meaning.en: 'Let me return home!'; the cry of someone ready to quit official life and go back to a simple life.
meaning.zh: 回去吧；表示辞官归隐、回归田园的决心。

equivalents: a call to withdraw to country life

examples.zh: 厌倦了职场，他萌生了归去来兮的念头。
examples.en: Tired of office life, he began to think of going home and retiring.

examples.zh: 每逢异乡过节，我总想念归去来兮的故园。
examples.en: Whenever I spend a festival away, I think of the home I long to return to.

story.en: After resigning as magistrate rather than 'bow for five pecks of rice', Tao Yuanming wrote: 'Let me go home! My fields and gardens are overgrown; why not return?'
story.zh: 陶渊明辞去彭泽令，作《归去来兮辞》：“归去来兮，田园将芜胡不归？”

usage.en: Literary, from the title of Tao Yuanming's rhapsody. 兮 is a classical particle. Often as a title or quotation.
usage.zh: 书面语，出自陶渊明辞赋题目。“兮”是古汉语语气词。常作标题或引用。

natural: pull a tooth from a tiger's mouth

meaning.en: To undertake something extremely dangerous.
meaning.zh: 比喻做非常危险的事。

equivalents: beard the lion in his den

examples.zh: 缉毒警察的工作就像虎口拔牙。
examples.en: The work of anti-drug police is like pulling a tooth from a tiger.

examples.zh: 跟垄断企业抢客户，无异于虎口拔牙。
examples.en: Competing with a monopoly for customers is like pulling a tiger's tooth.

usage.en: Describes risky ventures; may be admiring or cautionary. Predicate or object.
usage.zh: 形容极其冒险的行动，可带钦佩或警示。多作谓语、宾语。

meaning.en: Weak in power and short of support or manpower.
meaning.zh: 力量单薄，缺少帮手和支持。

equivalents: too few to make a difference

examples.zh: 对方人多势众，我们势单力薄，只能暂避锋芒。
examples.en: They outnumber us and we are too weak, so we must keep clear for now.

examples.zh: 她一个人势单力薄，需要更多志愿者加入。
examples.en: She is too few to cope alone and needs more volunteers.

usage.en: Describes lack of manpower or influence; 势单力孤 is a rarer form. Predicate.
usage.zh: 形容人手少、影响小；“势单力孤”较少见。多作谓语。

meaning.en: To stray completely from the subject of a talk or essay.
meaning.zh: 说话或写文章完全偏离主题。

examples.zh: 他的发言离题万里，主持人不得不打断。
examples.en: His speech was miles off topic and the chair had to interrupt.

examples.zh: 这篇作文离题万里，只能给低分。
examples.en: The essay was far off topic and could only get a low mark.

usage.en: Common in school and meeting contexts. Predicate.
usage.zh: 多用于考试、会议语境。多作谓语。

meaning.en: To act recklessly with no fear of consequences or restraint.
meaning.zh: 毫无顾忌，什么都不害怕。

examples.zh: 他有靠山，做事无所忌惮。
examples.en: He has backing and acts with no restraint.

examples.zh: 网络上有人躲在匿名背后无所忌惮地攻击别人。
examples.en: Some people hide behind anonymity online and attack others without fear.

usage.en: Derogatory; 无所忌惮 is similar to 肆无忌惮 (already an entry). Predicate.
usage.zh: 贬义；与“肆无忌惮”意近。多作谓语。

natural: cry to heaven and shout at earth

meaning.en: To wail loudly in grief or distress; also used of a dramatic fuss.
meaning.zh: 大声哭喊，形容极度悲痛，也形容大吵大闹。

examples.zh: 孩子摔了一跤，哭天喊地。
examples.en: The child fell over and wailed at the top of his voice.

examples.zh: 她哭天喊地，要求赔偿。
examples.en: She wept and made a loud scene, demanding compensation.

usage.en: Colloquial; can describe real grief or a performance. Predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 口语，可指真悲痛，也可指做作的哭闹。多作谓语、状语。

natural: embrace on the left and hold on the right

meaning.en: To be surrounded by many lovers or attendants; a life of excess and pleasure.
meaning.zh: 左右两边都搂着美女，形容生活荒淫享乐。

examples.zh: 他左拥右抱，过着纸醉金迷的生活。
examples.en: He leads a decadent life with lovers on every side.

examples.zh: 古时帝王左拥右抱，后宫佳丽三千。
examples.en: Ancient emperors lived in indulgence with thousands of consorts.

usage.en: Derogatory; implies dissolute pleasure. Predicate.
usage.zh: 贬义，暗指荒淫享乐。多作谓语。

natural: a red phoenix facing the sun

meaning.en: An auspicious scene; a rare talent meeting its opportunity, also a wish for good fortune, often used in art.
meaning.zh: 红凤凰朝向太阳，比喻吉祥的景象或贤才逢明时，常用于贺词和图案。

examples.zh: 墙上挂着一幅丹凤朝阳的刺绣。
examples.en: On the wall hangs an embroidery of a phoenix facing the sun.

examples.zh: 新店开张，祝你丹凤朝阳，生意兴隆。
examples.en: On the opening of your new shop, may fortune smile on you and business flourish.

usage.en: A lucky motif in painting, embroidery, congratulations. Attributive or object.
usage.zh: 画作、刺绣中的吉祥图案，也用于祝贺。多作定语、宾语。

pinyin: shùn wǒ zhě chāng, nì wǒ zhě wáng
literal: obey · me · one · thrive · defy · me · one · perish
natural: those who obey me prosper, those who defy me perish

meaning.en: A domineering stance: submit and do well, resist and be destroyed.
meaning.zh: 顺从我的就兴盛，违抗我的就灭亡，形容专横霸道。

examples.zh: 他搞一言堂，信奉顺我者昌，逆我者亡。
examples.en: He runs a one-man show on the principle of obeying him or else.

examples.zh: 这种顺我者昌，逆我者亡的作风，让人才纷纷离开。
examples.en: This my-way-or-the-highway style is driving talent away.

usage.en: Derogatory; describes tyrants and bullying bosses. Either half may be quoted alone. The older wording is 顺之者昌，逆之者亡. Clause.
usage.zh: 贬义，形容独裁、霸道。可只引一半。较早说法是“顺之者昌，逆之者亡”。多作分句。

meaning.en: Deeply profound and mysterious; sometimes so abstruse as to be incomprehensible.
meaning.zh: 玄妙深奥到极点，有时指难以捉摸。

examples.zh: 这套理论说得玄之又玄，没人听得懂。
examples.en: This theory is so mystifying that nobody can follow it.

examples.zh: 他把简单的问题讲得玄之又玄。
examples.en: He made a simple question sound unfathomably deep.

story.en: The first chapter of the Laozi says the Way is 'mysterious, and again mysterious: the gate of all wonders'.
story.zh: 《老子》第一章：“玄之又玄，众妙之门。”

usage.en: Originally praise in Daoism; today often a mild criticism of vague talk. Predicate.
usage.zh: 原为道家褒义，今多略带批评，指说得玄虚难懂。多作谓语。

natural: scented clothes and shadows of hair

meaning.en: A glamorous scene of elegantly dressed, fragrant women at a party.
meaning.zh: 衣裳飘香、鬓发闪影，形容盛装女子聚集的华丽场面。

examples.zh: 宴会上衣香鬓影，觥筹交错。
examples.en: The banquet was a glamorous scene of perfume, finery and clinking cups.

examples.zh: 老上海的舞厅里，衣香鬓影，一派繁华。
examples.en: In old Shanghai's dance halls, elegant guests created a scene of splendour.

usage.en: Literary, evokes high-society glamour. Attributive or predicate.
usage.zh: 书面语，带上流社会的华丽感。多作定语、谓语。

meaning.en: The more capable you are, the more work you are given.
meaning.zh: 能力强的人，承担的工作也多。

equivalents: if you're good, you get more work

examples.zh: 能者多劳，这个项目就拜托你了。
examples.en: The able are given the most work, so I'm leaving this project to you.

examples.zh: 他总说自己是能者多劳，其实只是不会拒绝。
examples.en: He always says capable people get more work, but really he just can't say no.

usage.en: Can be genuine praise, a polite request or a self-mocking complaint. Often in the form 能者多劳，多劳多得. Clause.
usage.zh: 可以是真诚赞美、客气请托或自嘲。常说“能者多劳”。多作分句。

meaning.en: A place full of bad people or bad influences; one gets used to the stink after a while.
meaning.zh: 卖咸鱼的店铺，比喻恶人聚集的环境，久居则习而不觉。

examples.zh: 与不善人居，如入鲍鱼之肆，久而不闻其臭。
examples.en: Living with bad people is like entering a fish-stall: you stop noticing the stench.

examples.zh: 这个圈子如同鲍鱼之肆，他想早日脱身。
examples.en: The circle is like a fish-market of bad influences, and he wants to leave soon.

story.en: Confucius said: 'Living with bad people is like entering a dried-fish shop; after a long time one no longer smells it, for one has become like it.'
story.zh: 《孔子家语·六本》：“与不善人居，如入鲍鱼之肆，久而不闻其臭，亦与之化矣。”

usage.en: Often used as a warning about environment and companions; compare 近墨者黑. Object.
usage.zh: 常用于告诫要谨慎择友、择居；可对照“近墨者黑”。多作宾语。

meaning.en: An iron tablet inscribed in cinnabar, given by an emperor to a meritorious subject, promising immunity from punishment.
meaning.zh: 古代帝王赐给功臣的凭证，用丹砂写在铁券上，可享特权或免死。

examples.zh: 开国功臣手握丹书铁券，可免一死。
examples.en: The founding hero held an iron tablet that spared him from death.

examples.zh: 别以为有了丹书铁券就能为所欲为。
examples.en: Don't think that having an imperial immunity pass lets you do whatever you like.

usage.en: A historical term; used figuratively for a privilege that shields one from consequences. Object.
usage.zh: 历史名词，比喻免受惩罚的特权。多作宾语。

natural: fragrance flowing for ten thousand ages

meaning.en: One's good name lives on for ever.
meaning.zh: 美名永远流传。

examples.zh: 英雄的事迹万古流芳。
examples.en: The hero's deeds will be remembered for ever.

examples.zh: 他们为国捐躯，名字万古流芳。
examples.en: They gave their lives for the country, and their names live for ever.

usage.en: Used for praise and memorials. Predicate.
usage.zh: 用于赞颂和纪念。多作谓语。

meaning.en: The sounds of chickens and dogs, a peaceful, lively rural village.
meaning.zh: 鸡啼犬叫的声音，形容安宁热闹的乡村生活。

examples.zh: 村中鸡鸣犬吠，一派田园气息。
examples.en: In the village there were chickens crowing and dogs barking, a pastoral scene.

examples.zh: 清晨的鸡鸣犬吠，勾起了他的乡愁。
examples.en: The crowing and barking of early morning stirred his homesickness.

usage.en: Peaceful and nostalgic; compare 鸡犬不宁, which is the opposite. Usually predicate or object.
usage.zh: 安宁怀旧；与“鸡犬不宁”意思相反。多作谓语、宾语。

meaning.en: Rash, clumsy and thoughtless, or looking slow and dull-witted.
meaning.zh: 鲁莽冒失，不动脑筋，或看上去呆头呆脑。

examples.zh: 这个愣头愣脑的小伙子闯进了会议室。
examples.en: The gawky young man blundered into the meeting room.

examples.zh: 他愣头愣脑地问了个不合时宜的问题。
examples.en: He rashly asked an ill-timed question.

usage.en: Colloquial; can be affectionate or mildly critical. Attributive or adverbial.
usage.zh: 口语，可亲昵，也可略带批评。多作定语、状语。

meaning.en: A very short distance, as far as an arrow can fly; also used to mean being almost there.
meaning.zh: 一支箭射出的距离，形容距离很近，也指即将成功。

examples.zh: 山顶只剩一箭之遥，大家加把劲。
examples.en: The summit is only a short way off, so let's push on.

examples.zh: 我们离冠军只有一箭之遥。
examples.en: We are one step from the championship.

usage.en: Used for distance and also for how close one is to a goal. Object or predicate.
usage.zh: 可指距离，也指离目标很近。多作宾语、谓语。

natural: crack bones and suck out the marrow

meaning.en: To exploit and oppress people ruthlessly, squeezing out every last drop.
meaning.zh: 榨取别人的血汗，极其残酷地剥削压榨。

examples.zh: 高利贷对穷人敲骨吸髓。
examples.en: Loan sharks bleed the poor dry.

examples.zh: 黑心老板敲骨吸髓，工人苦不堪言。
examples.en: The ruthless boss squeezed his workers dry and they suffered terribly.

usage.en: Strongly derogatory; used for cruel exploitation. Predicate.
usage.zh: 贬义极强，指残酷剥削。多作谓语。

natural: a mouth without a heart in it

meaning.en: To speak sharply without meaning any harm.
meaning.zh: 说话直率，嘴上厉害，其实并无恶意。

examples.zh: 别生气，他有口无心，说完就忘了。
examples.en: Don't be upset; he doesn't mean it and forgets it as soon as he's said it.

examples.zh: 我妈就是有口无心，其实最疼我。
examples.en: My mum is all talk with no ill intent and in fact loves me most.

usage.en: Used to excuse someone's harsh words; often with 刀子嘴豆腐心. Predicate.
usage.zh: 用于替人解释说话难听，常与“刀子嘴豆腐心”连用。多作谓语。

meaning.en: Fierce wild beasts; also vicious and cruel people.
meaning.zh: 凶猛的野兽，也比喻凶恶残暴的人。

examples.zh: 深山里豺狼虎豹出没，千万小心。
examples.en: Beasts roam deep in the mountains, so be careful.

examples.zh: 面对豺狼虎豹般的敌人，他毫不畏惧。
examples.en: He wasn't afraid of the savage enemy.

usage.en: Literal for animals; figurative for vicious people. Subject or object.
usage.zh: 字面指猛兽，比喻凶残之人。多作主语、宾语。

meaning.en: To accept a reward or favour one hasn't earned; often used politely to decline gifts.
meaning.zh: 没有功劳而接受赏赐，常用作婉拒礼物的客套话。

equivalents: accept what one has not earned

examples.zh: 无功受禄，寝食难安，这份礼我不能收。
examples.en: I can't sleep well on unearned rewards, so I cannot accept this gift.

examples.zh: 他无功受禄，同事们很不服气。
examples.en: He got rewarded without doing anything, and his colleagues were unhappy.

usage.en: The usual proverb is 无功不受禄 ('no merit, no reward'); the four-character form here is the same idea. Often used as a polite refusal.
usage.zh: 常说谚语“无功不受禄”，意思相近。常用作客气的推辞。
